The Skill matcher is a SECOND PostToolUse block, correctly separate (a matcher regex `Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|Skill` would work too but the split is clearer). Skill hook lines are live: 8 of 47 task dirs today carry {"log":{"msg":"skill: <name>"}} -- ai-rail, devbar-structure, panel-simplify, readme-retreat, report, report-full, task-status, vision-browse. Task selection for Skill: cached_task(agent_id) || find_task(session_id, newest=true) -- there is NO path ground truth for a skill call, so a skill fired by an agent that has not yet edited a file inside its own task dir lands on the NEWEST-CREATED task with a matching session_id, which for a subagent (inherits parent session_id) can be a SIBLING task.
